Key pattern: env var parameterization ($PAPERCLIP_DIR, $PAPERCLIP_DATA_DIR, $HOMELAB_DIR, $PAPERCLIP_API) with defaults in an Environment Variables table at the top of SKILL.md is the right approach for porting Pi skills to OpenClaw. OpenClaw cron `delivery.mode: "announce"` ALWAYS delivers the agent's reply to Telegram — even "all clear" / "exit silently" messages. The watchdog skill was designed to be silent-when-healthy but has been sending ~8 deliveries including no-op messages because announce mode has no content filter. For the new audit job this is actually desired (always-send), but any future "alert-only" cron job should NOT use announce — use `mode: "none"` and have the agent call message tool directly when needed.
